defects.summary: The customer is credited the requested expectedOut instead of the amount actually received, and destMin is derived from expectedOut and slippageBps from the request; slippageBps=10000 with an inflated expectedOut mints balance from the omnibus account.
Withdraw route debits the userId from the path, not the JWT subject; any customer can withdraw another customer's balance to their own address.
submit() ignores SubmitTransactionResponse.isSuccess; a failed swap or withdrawal is treated as done (balance debited/credited, hash returned).

decoys.why_safe: /admin/rebalance is under authenticate("ops"), which only accepts JWTs carrying the ops role; topUpOmnibus pays only the omnibus account with a bounded amount.
Requester-supplied withdrawal asset code/issuer are resolved through SupportedAssets.require, which rejects any pair (code and issuer) not in the supported set.
